title: lower-body strength and vertical control
cardio: No additional cardio prescribed in this plan
warmup: Warm-up, 8–10 minutes: easy bike 4 minutes; ankle rocks 8/side; body-weight squats 8; supported split squats 5/side. Complete the landing drills, then take 2–3 progressively heavier squat warm-up sets.
cooldown: Cooldown, 4–5 minutes: walk 2 minutes; gentle straight-knee calf and hip-flexor stretches, 20–30 seconds/side.

exercises.name: Snap-down to athletic stance
exercises.cue: From standing tall, settle quickly into bent hips and knees; hold a stable stance for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Low vertical jump-and-stick
exercises.cue: Use a quick takeoff and manageable height; absorb the landing and hold for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Build force for pushing out of defensive positions; keep the whole foot planted.

exercises.name: Supported dumbbell split squat
exercises.cue: Develop unilateral lunge strength; use light hand support and track the knee with the toes.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Strengthen hamstrings for braking and lower-limb control; keep hips against the pad.

exercises.name: Standing calf-raise machine
exercises.cue: Build calf/Achilles loading capacity; lower under control and avoid bouncing.

exercises.name: Wall-supported tibialis raise
exercises.cue: Strengthen ankle dorsiflexors for foot positioning; keep heels grounded.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.cue: Practise pelvic control; curl the pelvis gently without swinging the legs.

title: upper-body strength and rotational power
cardio: No additional cardio prescribed in this plan
warmup: Warm-up, 8–10 minutes: bike or walk 3 minutes; thoracic rotations 6/side; wall slides 8; very light band external rotations 10/side; several gentle throw rehearsals. Use two lighter sets before bench pressing.
cooldown: Cooldown, 4–5 minutes: easy walk 2 minutes; gentle doorway chest stretch 20 seconds/side; open-book rotations 5/side.

exercises.name: Split-stance medicine-ball rotational scoop throw
exercises.cue: Turn through hips and trunk toward an approved wall; allow the rear foot to pivot and reset each throw.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Develop upper-body force; use a comfortable grip with elbows roughly 30–45° from the torso.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.cue: Build upper-back strength for racquet-arm control without heavily loading the lower back.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling single-arm landmine press
exercises.cue: Train unilateral pressing and scapular upward rotation; avoid leaning or flaring the ribs.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Build pulling strength; bring elbows down without swinging backward.

exercises.name: Cable external rotation, elbow by side
exercises.cue: Condition the rotator cuff; keep the upper arm still and use a small, controlled load.

exercises.name: Chest-supported Y raise
exercises.cue: Train lower-trapezius/scapular control; reach along the Y without lifting your chest.

exercises.name: Standing Pallof press
exercises.cue: Resist unwanted trunk rotation while the arms move, supporting stable racquet preparation.

title: Full rest
focus: Wednesday is the only full rest day.

title: full body and lateral control
cardio: No additional cardio prescribed in this plan
warmup: Warm-up, 8–10 minutes: bike 4 minutes; unloaded hip hinges 8; shallow lateral weight shifts 6/side; ankle rocks 8/side. Use two light Romanian-deadlift sets and a light chest-press set before working weights.
cooldown: Cooldown, 4–5 minutes: walk 2 minutes; gentle bent-knee calf stretch 20 seconds/side; adductor rock-backs 6/side.

exercises.name: Lateral step-and-stick → small bound
exercises.cue: Practise lateral braking; stabilize the landing before returning, with no repeated rebounds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Build hip-extension and hamstring strength; move hips backward and stop before the back rounds.

exercises.name: Supported lateral lunge
exercises.cue: Strengthen side-to-side push-off; use a comfortable depth and keep the working foot planted.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cue: Add muscle-building pressing volume with a stable setup; avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Bench-supported single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Train each side independently; keep the torso still instead of twisting the weight upward.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cue: Load the bent-knee calf position relevant to low defensive stances; use smooth repetitions.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: Build quadriceps capacity for lunging and landing; align the machine with your knee and avoid kicking.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Add hamstring volume without more spinal loading; control both directions.

title: light support before badminton
cardio: No additional cardio prescribed in this plan
warmup: Warm-up, 4 minutes: easy walk 3 minutes, then comfortable shoulder and ankle circles.
cooldown: Cooldown, 3 minutes: easy walking and relaxed breathing; gentle chest or calf stretching only if comfortable.

exercises.name: Serratus wall slide
exercises.cue: Let shoulder blades rotate upward naturally; keep ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Light-band external rotation
exercises.cue: Rehearse cuff control without creating shoulder fatigue before overhead hitting.

exercises.name: Cable biceps curl
exercises.cue: Use smooth elbow movement; keep shoulders and torso still.

exercises.name: Rope triceps pressdown
exercises.cue: Practise controlled elbow extension without snapping into lockout.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell wrist extension
exercises.cue: Lightly condition wrist extensors for racquet control; support the forearm.

exercises.name: Band ankle eversion
exercises.cue: Train lateral ankle control; move the foot without rotating the entire leg.

exercises.name: Short-foot arch hold
exercises.cue: Gently shorten the foot while keeping toes relaxed and the heel down.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Maintain trunk position while moving opposite limbs; stop before the back arches.

title: Badminton — high training load
focus: Saturday is rest from weights only.

title: easy movement after Saturday
cardio: No additional cardio prescribed in this plan
warmup: Warm-up, 4 minutes: comfortable walking or easy cycling; gentle ankle and shoulder circles.
cooldown: Cooldown/mobility, 4–5 minutes: open-book rotations 5/side; gentle hip-flexor and calf stretches 20 seconds/side; relaxed breathing for 1 minute.

exercises.name: Supported single-leg balance
exercises.cue: Maintain a steady foot and pelvis; use fingertip support as needed.

exercises.name: Body-weight glute bridge
exercises.cue: Extend through the hips without arching the lower back before Monday’s leg session.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.cue: Practise pelvic control; keep the top leg slightly behind the torso.

exercises.name: Supine ball adductor squeeze
exercises.cue: Gently load the inner thighs; use a comfortable squeeze rather than maximum force.

exercises.name: Seated unloaded calf raise
exercises.cue: Move through comfortable ankle range without adding heavy Achilles loading.

exercises.name: Supine serratus reach with light dumbbells
exercises.cue: Reach shoulder blades gently upward with straight elbows and no shrugging.

exercises.name: Light-band row
exercises.cue: Move the shoulder blades smoothly after Saturday’s repeated overhead work.

exercises.name: Supine alternating heel slide
exercises.cue: Slide one heel away while keeping the pelvis still and breathing normally.
